summary: Dead-end road tip backing onto bush, with homes 18 m away.
reasons: Homes 18-19 m away on this side

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush at the road end and a vacant lot to the south; nearest dwellings 18-19 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches the end; a car and a boat are parked just before it. Section is only 12 m, about one van.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end street; almost no through traffic.
drivers.convention: Vehicles and a boat park near the end; no camping convention.

flags: Section is barely one van long
sun_shade: Heavy bush shade from the north and west; open to the east and south.
cannot_judge: Turning room at the road end

best_section.where: At the very end of Aragon Street, where the sealed road meets bush
